7251670.name: Chabad of Lachine
7251670.note: COLlive, 8 Nov 2026 ('New Shluchim to Lachine, Montreal'): 'Rabbi Fully and Goldi Wilmowsky, together with their baby Fayga, have moved to Lachine, Montreal, Quebec to establish a new Chabad Center'; 'Since arriving ... We welcomed community members for Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur services, hosted Sukkos celebrations, and established weekly Shabbos services'; 'The last synagogue in Lachine closed its doors in 1944.' Its chabad.org listing went up 13 Apr 2026.

331810.name: Chabad of Chomedey & Laval
331810.note: No founding year found yet. COLlive, 3 July 2012 ('City Marks Rabbi's 25 Years'): Rabbi David Raphael Banon 'is marking 25 years since he has been appointed spiritual leader of Centre Communautaire Sepharade in Chomedey and subsequently Chabad Shliach of Chomedey', so the Chabad came after 1987; COLlive, 22 Oct 2009, calls the Centre Communautaire Sépharade de Chomedey 'a congregation founded in 1993'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2005-12-01, so it existed by then. Director: David Raphael Banon.
